course.title: Computer Organization and Architecture
course.overview: Comprehensive 3rd-Year University course covering Computer System Organization and Architecture, Historical Computing Evolution, Quantitative Performance Assessment (Clock Cycles, CPI, MIPS, MFLOPS, Amdahl's Law, Little's Law), Top-Level Interconnection Structures, Instruction Cycle State Transitions, Hardware Interrupt Handling Mechanisms, Bus Topologies and Arbitration, Hierarchical Cache Memory Design (Direct, Associative, Set-Associative Mapping, Replacement Algorithms, Write-Through vs Write-Back), Semiconductor Main Memory Architectures (DRAM, SRAM, SDRAM, DDR), and Error-Correcting Codes (Hamming Distance and SEC-DED).
